rule_en: Mixed conditionals cross time: past condition → present result (If + past perfect, would + base) or present condition → past result (If + past simple, would have + past participle).
rule_bn: সময় মেশানো: অতীত শর্ত → বর্তমান ফল (If + past perfect, would + base); বর্তমান শর্ত → অতীত ফল (If + past simple, would have + past participle)।

sessions.title: Spot the Error
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the wrong word, then choose the fix.

items.prompt_en: If I had taken that offer, I will be in Dubai now
items.explain_en: Past condition, present result → would + base now.

items.prompt_en: If she wasn't so busy, she would have joined us yesterday
items.explain_en: A general present state in the if-clause → were(n't) for unreal.

items.prompt_en: If you had set up alerts, you wouldn't being blind to errors now
items.explain_en: A present result of a past condition → wouldn't + base.

items.prompt_en: If he was better at delegating, he wouldn't have burned out last quarter
items.explain_en: An unreal present trait → were; the past result keeps would have + participle.

items.prompt_en: If we hadn't chosen microservices, deployment will be simpler today
items.explain_en: A past choice with a present consequence → would + base.

items.prompt_en: If I didn't trusted the team, I would have reviewed every line yesterday
items.explain_en: didn't + base verb: trust.

items.prompt_en: If you had documented the API, new hires would been faster now
items.explain_en: would + base for a present result: would be.

items.prompt_en: If she weren't the only admin, she could had taken a real vacation
items.explain_en: could have + past participle for the unreal past result.

items.prompt_en: If we had hired earlier, we are not so behind on the roadmap
items.explain_en: Past condition, present result → wouldn't be.

items.prompt_en: If I knew Apex better, I would have wrote the trigger myself last sprint
items.explain_en: Past participle after 'would have': written.

sessions.title: Choose & Fill
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the correct option or chip.

items.prompt_en: If I had learned to touch-type, I ___ much faster today.
items.explain_en: Past condition → present result: would + base.

items.prompt_en: If she ___ so stubborn, she would have accepted the feedback.
items.explain_en: A permanent trait now → were(n't); the result stays in the past.

items.prompt_en: If we hadn't migrated to the cloud, we ___ for new servers right now.
items.explain_en: Past condition → present continuous result: would be + verb-ing.

items.prompt_en: He ___ yesterday's standup in person if he lived closer to the office.
items.explain_en: Present condition → past result: would have + past participle.

items.prompt_en: If money ___ no object, I would have bought the M3 Max last year.
items.explain_en: A condition still true now → were; the result sits in the past.

items.prompt_en: If I had finished the report yesterday, I ___ relaxing now.
items.explain_en: Past condition → present result: would + base.

items.prompt_en: If he weren't so careful, he ___ that edge case last week.
items.explain_en: Present trait → past result: would have + past participle.

items.prompt_en: If we used feature flags, yesterday's rollback ___ one click.
items.explain_en: Present habit (we don't) → past result: would have taken.

items.prompt_en: If they had automated the tests, they ___ every release by hand now.
items.explain_en: Past condition → present result: wouldn't + base.

items.prompt_en: If I ___ allergic to cats, I would have adopted one years ago.
items.explain_en: A still-true condition → weren't; the past result keeps would have + participle.

sessions.title: Build It
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the tiles in the right order. For speak items, say it out loud.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If I had taken that job , I would live in London .
items.explain_en: Past condition (had taken) → present result (would live).

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If she had saved her notes , she wouldn't need my help .
items.explain_en: Past mistake → present consequence: wouldn't + base.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If he were braver , he would have asked for a raise .
items.explain_en: Present trait (were) → past result (would have asked).

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If we had written tests , this refactor would feel safe .
items.explain_en: Past condition → how things would feel now.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If I weren't on call , I would have gone to the concert .
items.explain_en: Present condition (weren't) → past result (would have gone).

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If they had picked Postgres , scaling would be much easier .
items.explain_en: Past choice → present consequence: would be.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If I knew the autosave worked , I would have skipped the manual backup .
items.explain_en: Present belief (knew) → past action skipped.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If she hadn't muted the channel , she would know the plan .
items.explain_en: Past action (hadn't muted) → present knowledge (would know).

items.prompt_en: Say how your life would be different now if you had studied something else.
items.model_en: If I had studied design, I would be building interfaces instead of triggers.

items.prompt_en: Describe a past decision that still helps you, using a mixed conditional.
items.model_en: If I hadn't joined that first startup, I wouldn't have this network today.
